S10 E24 — Pups Save a Runaway Robo-Chicken Purse; Pups Save the Buggy Trekkers
Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E15 — Pups Save the Marooned Mayors; Pups Save the Game Show
While ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get stuck in an ice crevasse; Beryl hosts a game show at the Wingnuts' farm.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E02 — Pups Save a Teeny Penguin; Pups Save the Cat Show
Everest and Jake try to rescue a little penguin and end up floating out to sea on a homemade bridge; Katie's kittens are all covered in mud and running amuck, so the pups must round them up before the Cat Show is ruined.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E08 — Pups and the Big Freeze; Pups Save a Basketball Game
A winter ice storm causes trouble throughout Adventure Bay; Mayor Goodway challenges Mayor Humdinger's basketball team to a game.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E24 — Moto Pup: Pups Save a Sneezy Chase; Moto Pups: Rescue at Twisty Top Mesa
Moto Pups must rescue the baddies off the Twisty Top Mesa; Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, and he's trapped with the Ruff Ruff Pack.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E21 — Dancing With Luke Stars; Pups Save a Mischievous Octopus
A dance contest being judged by Luke Stars goes wrong when a floating dance floor carries the contestants away; the pups investigate a mystery at an undersea-themed museum exhibit and discover an octopus that wants to return to the ocean.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E10 — Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew; Pups Save the Glasses
Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties; Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E17 — Mighty Pups Stop the Mighty Queen; Mighty Pups Stop the Hiccups
The Mighty Pups must stop Sweetie from using her new powers to take over Adventure Bay; Mighty Nano gets the hiccups, so it's up to Liberty and the Mighty Pups to find a cure.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E03 — Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show
When Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds, Chickaletta joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the mayor's corny plan; when Humdinger steals Katie and Cali's tiaras, it's up to the pups to save their costumes and the pet show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E24 — Pups Save a Pizza; Pups Save Skye
While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident; a storm causes Skye to crash-land in the snow while on her way to Jake's Mountain.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E07 — Genie in a Bubble!
When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E13 — Too Bright for Movie Night!
If the Moon People can find a way to make it dark during the day, the Sun People agree to turn off their giant night light so the Moon People can enjoy their movie night.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E10 — The Jaw-some Sharkventure!
Zooli and her crew of marine biologists escort their new friends Baby Shark and his pilot fish, William, to visit Baby Shark's great-great-great-great-great Uncle Slow Mo and help them escape the determined fisherman who's chasing them.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S02 E10 — Milli Saves the Day
Milli must save her friends when they get stuck in honey and scooped up by a bear.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S02 E18 — Umi Toy Store
The team must search through a toy store for their friend's lost Umicents.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E20 — Pups Get Skunked; Pups and a Whale of a Tale
When Everest gets sprayed by a skunk, the pups tell her delicately that she needs a bath; the pups fly north to help free a baby whale that is trapped under the ice.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E06 — Pups Save Jake's Cake; Pups Save a Wild Ride
Ryder and the pups must help get a surprise birthday cake up to Jake's cabin; the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Alex and Daring Danny X snowboard toward Risky Ridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E04 — Pups Save Alex's Mini-Patrol; Pups Save a Lost Tooth
Alex sets up his own mini-patrol, recruiting Chickaletta, Cali, Turtle, and Bunny; Alex loses his first tooth and then misplaces it.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E08 — The Crew Builds Charger a Super Bed; The Crew Builds a Super Squirrely Whirly Playground
Charger has got too much energy to sleep; Rubble and Crew know there's always a construction solution; Rubble and the pups build Mix, Motor, Lucas, and Lily a Super Squirrely Whirly playdate.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E24 — The Crew and Rocky Build a Bear Island
Rocky visits Rubble and Crew from Adventure Bay just in time to see Builder Cove's new baby bear; when Park Ranger Rose asks for construction help, Speed Meister accidentally ruins the bears' home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E26 — Pups Bark With Dinosaurs
The pups must catch three baby pterodactyls after they hatch from fossilized eggs unearthed on an excavation dig.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E24 — Pups Save Francois the Penguin; Pups Save Daring Danny's Hippo
Francois and a baby penguin get caught on the other side of a crevasse; Daring Danny wants a cool pet of his own.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E17 — Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties; Pups Save a Helo Humdinger
When Mayor Humdinger tricks Katie into watching his kitties, an alarm system is set off and the PAW Patrol must rescue them; when Mayor Humdinger swipes one of Ryder's early inventions he must be rescued from an out-of-control flight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E13 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save Tilly Turbot; Pups Save an Upset Elephant
The PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot and Francois' Grandma Tilly after she rides off on a dolphin; Carlos and Tracker call the PAW Patrol to help solve the mystery of a rumbling sound that is upsetting the jungle elephants.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Sibling School; Patchwork Quilt; New Baby; Baby Names; Holding the Baby
Peppa and George learn how to be the best siblings; Peppa is making a quilt for the baby; on the day of the baby's arrival, Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa's Circus; Night Animals; Pirate Treasure; Garden Games; Going Boating
Peppa and her friends put on a circus; Peppa and George stay up late to hunt for slugs and snails; Pirate Peppa buries a treasure chest; Daddy Pig gives Peppa an old box of garden games; everyone goes boating at the lake.

title: My Friend Maisy
description:
S01 E02 — Bus Ride
Maisy is curious, creative and independent; Maisy can go anywhere and be anything, adventuring with her lovable group of friends.

title: It's Andrew!
description:
S01 E04 — Big Big Rocky Rock
It's rock day at school and each little one brings in their favorite rock to show.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Pedro the Cowboy; Peppa & George's Garden; The Flying Vet; International Day; Potato City
Pedro Pony pretends to be a cowboy; Grandpa Pig gives the children seeds for their garden; nearly all the animals need Dr. Hamster's help on the same day; Peppa and her friends dress up; Peppa and her family visit a new theme park.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Ballet Lesson; Grandpa Pig's Boat; Tidying Up; Picnic; Daddy Puts Up a Picture
Peppa is excited about her first ballet lesson; Granny and Grandpa Pig have a little boat; Peppa and George have to clean their bedroom; the family goes on a picnic; Mummy Pig has a new picture.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Move to Music; School Project; Simple Science; Pedro Is Late; Gerald Giraffe
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music; for their school project, Peppa and her friends build castles and bring them into playgroup.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mr. Bull Is Getting Married; Getting Ready for a Wedding; The Wedding Day; Party Bus; Families
Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married; everyone gets ready for the wedding; the day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull's wedding arrives; Peppa gets an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party; the children draw family pictures.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Around the World; Castle; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
Miss Rabbit lends Peppa and her family a plane for the day, and they get swept off on an adventure around the world; the family visits a castle; when Miss Rabbit's train breaks down, Grandpa Pig lends her his little train, Gertrude.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Roller Disco; Weather Station; Talking; Grandpa's Rock Garden; Winter Games
Madame Gazelle has organized a roller disco; the children learn about the weather; there is a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama; Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden; Peppa and family go skiing.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best of Mighty Pups: Super Paws
A collection of the PAW Patrol's Super Paw rescues.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S14 E07 — A Zuma Pirate Adventure
Having made a big blunder in a recent rescue, Zuma trades in his usual chill attitude and becomes a super serious pup; his new persona gets tested when an actual pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and willing to destroy things to get it!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E22 — Pups Save a Talkative Mini Patrol; Pups Save the History of Adventure Bay
Alex dreams that his Mini Patrol animals can talk; the animals take the Bookmobile on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger steals the ancient book.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E16 — Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E09 — Air Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-stronaut
Captain Gordy and his space shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite! But when Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies, the space shuttle blasts off with him still inside! Air Rescue pups save him.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E26 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save Puplantis
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E13 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Baby Octopus
The Sea Patrol must save the day when a baby octopus gets separated from its mother and sinks the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best Daring Rescues
A collection of the PAW Patrol's extreme rescues with Daring Danny X.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E13 — Mighty Pups Stop a Mighty Eel; Pups Save a Floating Royal Carriage
When an eel accidentally swallows a piece of the meteor and becomes gigantic, it's up to the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay; after Sweetie decides to commandeer the Princess's royal carriage and horses, Sid the pirate sends Arrby to steal it.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E02 — Pups Meet the Cat Pack
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E14 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Tigers
When searching for elusive rumble top tigers, the Turbots fall into a cave deep inside a volcano; the PAW Patrol performs a paratrooper-style rescue from Skye's ultimate copter.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E21 — Pups and Cats Save HumCatDingerMan; Pups Save a Turbot Tournament
Mayor Humdinger becomes HumCatDingerMan to steal the spotlight from Cat Pack; the pups must save Tilly during the Turbot Tournament.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E24 — Pups Save a Lonesome Walrus; Pups Save the Hummy Gummies
Wally the Walrus searches all over Adventure Bay for Cap'n Turbot and turns the town upside-down in the process; everybody loves Helga Humdinger's Hummy Gummy treats, causing Mayor Humdinger to get jealous and steal them all.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E04 — Pup Pup Boogie; Pups in a Fog
Rubble hurts his paw while trying to fix the train tracks; Ryder and the PAW Patrol must fix the bulb in the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E23 — Pups Save the Floating Goodways; Pups Save the Portable Pet Wash
The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan-shaped float and need rescue from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable; Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E12 — Pups Save a Chicken Tulip; Pups Stop an Xtreme Shark
When Mayor Humdinger and his mother help Mayor Goodway look for a rare tulip, Humdinger gets them all in trouble; the pups must save Daring Danny X when a mechanical shark stunt goes awry.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E21 — Parroting Pups; Merpups Save the Turbots
When Rocky loses his voice, Matea the parrot helps him bark out his pup pack tools; the Merpups return to help the PAW Patrol on a rescue.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E11 — Pups Save the Skydivers; Pups Save the Cupcakes
Mayor Goodway and farmer Al are ready for a day filled with skydiving fun; Alex and the Mini Patrol get locked inside the flounder.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E04 — Guppy Movers!
When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E22 — Bubble Puppysaurus!
When small-town "puppy-saurus" Bubble Puppy gets picked to go against the reigning champ Boom Boom T. rex in the Tough Roarier competition, it's a battle of strength, speed and, above all, heart.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E25 — Super Guppies!
When Molly and Gil bring a comic book to school, the Guppies are inspired, and they all want to be superheroes.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S01 E10 — Special Delivery
Anthony forgets to put a stamp on a package for his grandmother; the team heads to the post office and into the mail system to catch up to the errant package.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E06 — Little Panda Joe
The team finds a baby panda in Umi City and helps him get back to his family.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E07 — Pups Save the Hiding Elephants; Pups Save a Yodeler
Elephants become trapped in the Monkey Temple after a bee frightens them away from their watering hole; Wingnut runs away from wolves that are attracted to his yodeling and he ends up trapped in a canyon.
